notes: Subtlety at 60, hand-curated from simmed candidates (design/reviews/2026-10-07-rogue-curation.md). The stealth opener (Stealth, Premeditation, Ambush) is unchanged. In the fight, Hemorrhage builds and keeps its Rupture-amplifying debuff up, Ghostly Strike goes on cooldown, Rupture is the main finisher whenever it has lapsed, and Eviscerate and Slice and Dice spend the combo points that build while it runs. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst.

expected_idle.reason: Sinister Strike is gated `not spellIsKnown(Hemorrhage/16511)`, the fallback builder for a bare build below Hemorrhage's talent row (Subtlety tier 4). At every level this ladder's own zero_casts check flags it, the truncated talent build has already spent points on Hemorrhage, so the gate correctly keeps Sinister Strike idle and lets Hemorrhage claim the builder slot instead -- the fallback yielding as designed, not a defect.

Eviscerate and Slice and Dice only spend combo points built while Rupture is running. At levels 20 and 30 energy is scarce enough that every set of four combo points goes straight into Rupture, which is cast again as soon as it ends, so no points are left for either; from level 38 they are cast.
Same as Eviscerate above: at level 20 (and, when it is learned, 30) no combo points are left over while Rupture is running.

engineering_notes.5: Fix round: the ladder's bare build has zero points in Hemorrhage below the level its tier is reachable (tier 4 of the Subtlety tree), leaving no combo-point builder at all -- the same auraIsKnown/spellIsKnown gate shape mage-fire uses for Improved Scorch (12873).
engineering_notes.2: Previously starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit here instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five combo points.

priorityList.notes: Ghostly Strike on cooldown: cheaper than Backstab, hits for 180% weapon damage with a dagger, and builds a combo point.
Rupture at four or more combo points whenever it is not running. Hemorrhage makes the target take 15% more Rupture damage, so Rupture is this tree's main finisher.
Eviscerate at three or more combo points while Rupture is running, so combo points built during a Rupture are spent instead of idling.
Slice and Dice while Rupture is running: opened when it is down, refreshed under 3 seconds remaining, at three or more combo points.

Hemorrhage as the builder: 145% weapon damage with a dagger, one combo point, and the debuff that lifts Rupture damage by 15% for 15 seconds. Gated on spellIsKnown so a build without the talent falls through to Sinister Strike.
Sinister Strike is the fallback builder whenever you have not talented into Hemorrhage.
